angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 699,874 km at 149.35 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.6956 +/- 0.0115 mas (same row, RUWE 0.98): 149.35 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.006 +/- 0.009 solar radii from Gill et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2447 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.533..109G/abstract): 699,874 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.034 +/- 0.032 solar masses from Gill et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2447 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.533..109G/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5730 +/- 80 K from Gill et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2447 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.533..109G/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Gill et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2447 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.533..109G/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-2447.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.447, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, CD-32 1952: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2447 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.18 dex, from Gill et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.533..109G/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2447 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.04891, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2447 (pscomppars): age 2.1 Gyr, from Gill et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.533..109G/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2447 (pscomppars): rotation period 13 d, from Gill et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.533..109G/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2447 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3.5 km/s, from Gill et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.533..109G/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (1.006 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.894. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
